what_happened: On a multi-lane highway with the command STRAIGHT (then RIGHT), the ego slowed and steered left toward the adjacent left lane instead of following the recorded path, which stayed in its lane and bore slightly right. It cut into actor 41, which was coming up alongside on the left, and hit it with its front-left corner. The camera shows the white car right beside the ego at impact.

On an open highway with no lead within about 48 m, the ego braked hard for no reason after handoff (20.3 to 9.0 m/s) and fell about 9 m behind its recorded position. Actor 1, a replayed car in the left lane that was moving right toward the ego's lane, then ended up against the ego's front-left corner, giving a front collision, and a car behind also rear-ended the ego.

On a multi-lane highway with the command STRAIGHT (RIGHT in the last frame), the ego's planned path bent left, away from the recorded path, which stayed in its lane or bore right. The ego drifted into the lane on its left and hit vehicle 41 there with its front-left at about 4.7 m/s.

The ego's planned path kept bending left out of its lane on a straight multi-lane freeway, while the route command was STRAIGHT and then RIGHT. At 7.7 s the ego drifted about 1.5 m left of the recorded trajectory, into the next lane over, and its front hit car 41, which was driving alongside in that lane.

On a straight highway the policy braked hard for no visible reason (20.6 to 9 m/s, with nothing close ahead) and drifted left while slowing. Its front-left corner clipped actor 1, which was beside it and slightly ahead in the left lane. The hard braking probably also caused the later rear contact.

On a straight multi-lane highway, the ego braked hard for no clear reason, from about 20 to 9 m/s with no lead closer than 46 m, and fell behind the recorded human position. At the same time it drifted and angled left into the next lane, and its front-left corner struck actor 1, which was driving alongside in that lane. The later rear contact most likely came from traffic behind reacting to the sudden braking.

In slow highway traffic (about 3.5 m/s), the ego drifted left out of its lane, ending up 2.2 m left of the recorded path. Its planned path also pointed left, even though the route command was RIGHT/STRAIGHT. Actor 51 was coming up from behind in the lane to the left, and the ego's side hit it in a sideswipe.

On a multi-lane road in slow traffic, the ego sped up from 2.2 to 4.6 m/s and steered left out of its lane (the orange planned path bends left, away from the recorded straight path). Its front hit vehicle 56 in the adjacent left lane, which was alongside and slightly ahead, even though the route command was STRAIGHT and then RIGHT.

In slow freeway traffic, the ego followed actor 12, a slower car in its lane about 6–7 m ahead. It sped up from 3.2 to 5.2 m/s instead of braking. Rather than move left as the recorded human did, it edged right alongside 12 and its front hit the car at 11.7 s.

On a multi-lane highway, the ego was following vehicle 12 at about 7 m. Its plan then veered left into the next lane, and its front hit vehicle 56, which was travelling in that lane just ahead and to its left. The recorded human trajectory stayed in the original lane behind 12.

In slow highway traffic at about 3.5 m/s, the ego drifted left out of its recorded lane, about 2 m off the human path, even though the route command was RIGHT/STRAIGHT. Actor 51 was coming up from behind in that left lane and hit the ego's side (lateral collision).

The ego was going straight in a busy multi-lane road and closing fast on the blue pickup ahead (actor 5): the gap shrank from 16.8 m to 5.7 m while the ego held about 9.5 m/s. The policy took over at 4.7 s with only 5.7 m of gap left, slowed from 9.3 to 7.6 m/s, and its front still hit the pickup 0.5 s later at 5.2 s (the ego was later also rear-ended).

The ego was going straight at about 9.5 m/s behind a slower blue pickup (actor 5) in its own lane, and the gap shrank from 16.8 m to 5.7 m by handoff at 4.7 s. In the 0.5 s it had control, the policy slowed only from 9.3 to 7.6 m/s, and the ego's front hit the pickup at 5.2 s while still on the recorded path (0.1 m off).

In stop-and-go highway traffic, the ego drove straight in its lane and closed on a slower blue pickup ahead (actor 5): the gap shrank from 12.8 m to 5.7 m at about 9.5 m/s before the policy took over at 4.7 s. The policy braked (9.3 to 7.6 m/s), but 0.5 s later at 5.2 s the ego's front hit the pickup while still on the recorded path (0.04 m off). Something also hit the ego's rear at some point.

The ego was going straight on the highway at about 11 m/s and ran into the back of slower lead vehicle 1 in its lane. The gap fell from 19.8 m to 5.5 m before handoff at 4.6 s, giving the policy about 1 s before impact. It braked only to 9.6 m/s, not enough to avoid the front collision at 5.1 s.

The ego was going straight on a multi-lane freeway at about 11 m/s. It was closing on slower lead vehicle 1 in its own lane at about 5.6 m/s, and the gap shrank from 20 m to 5.5 m before the policy took over at 4.6 s. The policy braked only moderately (11.1 to 9.6 m/s) and rear-ended actor 1 half a second after handoff, at 5.1 s.

The ego was going straight at about 11 m/s and closing on a slower lead car (actor 1) in its lane; the gap shrank from 20 m to 5.5 m by the time the policy took over at 4.6 s. The policy braked only to about 9.6 m/s, and the ego's front hit actor 1's rear at 5.1 s. Rear contact on the ego was also flagged, but the front collision came first.

On a straight multi-lane freeway the ego was going about 11 m/s and closing on a slower SUV (actor 1) ahead in its own lane, at roughly 5.6 m/s. When the policy took over at 4.6 s the gap was only 5.5 m, about 1 s to impact; it braked only gently (to 9.6 m/s) and hit the SUV's rear at 5.1 s. A follower also hit the ego from behind.

On a straight multi-lane highway the ego came in at about 11 m/s, closing on slower lead vehicle 1 in its own lane (the gap shrank from 19.8 m to 5.5 m before handoff). The policy took over at 4.6 s with about 1 s to collision, braked only from 11.1 to 9.6 m/s, and hit actor 1 front-first at 5.1 s; the ego was also rear-ended at some point.

On the highway, the ego sped up from 3.7 to 5.1 m/s in its lane, with actor 7 just ahead-left in the next lane. At 11.7 s the ego's front-left corner, angled slightly left, clipped actor 7 (a front collision). The ego was only 1.7 m off the recorded path, so it isn't clear whether the ego drifted left or replayed actor 7 edged right; the vehicle ahead in its own lane (48) was never close.

Driving straight on a highway at about 5 m/s, the ego's planned path bent left toward the next lane while actor 7 was driving alongside it, just ahead on the left. The ego drifted about 1.7 m off the recorded human path and hit actor 7 with its front-left corner. The camera view was clear before the impact, so a rendering problem doesn't explain the move.
